label: Gorgias connection
description: Connect your Gorgias helpdesk. After you save, the app connects within about a minute. Choose Test connection to check the subdomain, email and API key.

actions.label: Test connection
actions.hint: Checks the subdomain, agent email and API key with Gorgias

fields.label: Agent email
fields.description: Email of the Gorgias agent the API key belongs to

fields.label: API key
fields.description: Gorgias REST API key (Settings → You → REST API)
